description: Defines UI widgets 'SectionHeader' and 'FeatureCard' for a Flutter application, used to build sections and feature display cards in the UI.

classes.name: SectionHeader
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that displays a section header with a title and optional 'See all' button.

classes.name: FeatureCard
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that displays a clickable card with an icon, title, subtitle, and optional background color.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI component for each widget, rendering the visual layout.
